dialogues.source: Yeesh… Awkward….
dialogues.target: Yeesh… Awkward….

dialogues.source: Well, that was unexpected… But that’s another thing I love about this diner. Everyone has a different story to tell! There are so many unique people that come here, and it’s usually great if we want to gather information. Just listen around…
dialogues.target: Well, that was unexpected… But that’s another thing I love about this diner. Everyone has a different story to tell! There are so many unique people that come here, and it’s usually great if we want to gather information. Just listen around…

dialogues.source: By the way Tyler, did you see the weird electrical storm last night at the start of the pine forest?
dialogues.target: By the way Tyler, did you see the weird electrical storm last night at the start of the pine forest?

dialogues.source: No, I was busy looking for my clothes actually.
dialogues.target: No, I was busy looking for my clothes actually.

dialogues.source: Your… clothes?
dialogues.target: Your… clothes?

dialogues.source: Yeah, don’t laugh, but I think someone stole a bunch of my clothes. I was drying them on the clothesline in my garden yesterday when they disappeared. Luckily, I never wash my cap, so that’s something they’re not going to get to that easily!
dialogues.target: Yeah, don’t laugh, but I think someone stole a bunch of my clothes. I was drying them on the clothesline in my garden yesterday when they disappeared. Luckily, I never wash my cap, so that’s something they’re not going to get to that easily!

dialogues.source: Dude, that’s kind of disgusting…
dialogues.target: Dude, that’s kind of disgusting…

dialogues.source: You think it might’ve been one of those hobos that people have been talking about lately? Apparently, we got a ton that suddenly moved into town.
dialogues.target: You think it might’ve been one of those hobos that people have been talking about lately? Apparently, we got a ton that suddenly moved into town.

dialogues.source: That is so weird…
dialogues.target: That is so weird…

dialogues.source: Then again, we shouldn’t be too surprised.
dialogues.target: Then again, we shouldn’t be too surprised.

dialogues.source: The Falls are full of strange occurrences.
dialogues.target: The Falls are full of strange occurrences.

dialogues.source: Very true…
dialogues.target: Very true…

dialogues.source: Mister Tyler!
dialogues.target: Mister Tyler!

dialogues.source: Hey! What are you doing?
dialogues.target: Hey! What are you doing?

dialogues.source: Could we investigate the place where your clothes were stolen? We’d like to help out.
dialogues.target: Could we investigate the place where your clothes were stolen? We’d like to help out.

dialogues.source: Eh… My house is locked so you two can’t steal anything. Sure, whatever. I live on the third street after the laser tag building.
dialogues.target: Eh… My house is locked so you two can’t steal anything. Sure, whatever. I live on the third street after the laser tag building.

dialogues.source: Wait a second!
dialogues.target: Wait a second!

dialogues.source: Thank you sir!
dialogues.target: Thank you sir!

dialogues.source: Though if you mess anything up, I’ll get you…
dialogues.target: Though if you mess anything up, I’ll get you…

dialogues.source: Wow, wow! Slow down there Pacifica! We haven’t even gotten our food yet.
dialogues.target: Wow, wow! Slow down there Pacifica! We haven’t even gotten our food yet.

dialogues.source: We’re going to investigate! Food is best served after hard work. We can come back later!
dialogues.target: We’re going to investigate! Food is best served after hard work. We can come back later!

dialogues.source: You wake me up and tempt me with all that food and now you’re dragging me out before I can even have a bite?
dialogues.target: You wake me up and tempt me with all that food and now you’re dragging me out before I can even have a bite?

dialogues.source: How could you?!
dialogues.target: How could you?!

dialogues.source: Come on, it’ll be fun!
dialogues.target: Come on, it’ll be fun!

dialogues.source: Imagine how cool it will be once we uncover all of this town’s secrets, we might even find a lead on the Blue Dorito!
dialogues.target: Imagine how cool it will be once we uncover all of this town’s secrets, we might even find a lead on the Blue Dorito!

dialogues.source: Although I'm still unsure about what to do first…
dialogues.target: Although I'm still unsure about what to do first…

dialogues.source: Wait, I still haven't agreed to this!
dialogues.target: Wait, I still haven't agreed to this!

dialogues.source: Let's talk about this over…
dialogues.target: Let's talk about this over…

dialogues.source: …over food?
dialogues.target: …over food?

dialogues.source: Nope! So which one do you think we should go to first?
dialogues.target: Nope! So which one do you think we should go to first?

dialogues.source: Stop deciding things without me!
dialogues.target: Stop deciding things without me!
